titulo: Walking to the door, then turning to say bye
caption:
Walking to the door, then turning to say bye

My uncle walks to the door first. Then he turns around to say goodbye.

People tend to remember how an encounter ended more than how the middle went, so the last few seconds of a visit do a lot of the work.

For whoever turns around at the door to say goodbye.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the right. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one near the middle and a royal blue one on the left. The black one walks quietly toward the door and, standing at it, turns around with a pulse and a bubble that says bye! The blue one answers bye! with happy eyes. Then the door opens and the black one walks out of the frame. The door closes and the blue one pulses. The text stays: me walking out then saying bye. The last card: Choose friction.
